why: I build web apps in Next.js and most of them end up deployed on Vercel, so I already know the product from the user side. Last summer I moved a dashboard's data fetching to the edge and cut load times from 2.1 seconds to 600 ms, and that was my favorite part of the job. I want to see how the platform behind that is built and spend a summer shipping code with the team that owns it.
project: Shuttle, a Next.js app that shows live arrival times for the UCF campus shuttles. It polls the GPS feed every 15 seconds, caches it at the edge and streams updates to the page, and about 1,200 students use it each week. The hard part was keeping estimates honest when the feed drops out, so I added a fallback that predicts arrivals from the route schedule.
